name: COSMOS (California State Summer School for Mathematics and Science) at UC Davis
what_you_do: You spend four weeks living on campus. It is a summer program with college-level math and science courses. You also do hands-on projects.
who_can_apply: California high school students completing grades 8 to 12. Non-California residents and international students cannot apply. Selected on academic strength and interest in math and science. You pick one campus and cluster choices.
pay_detail: Program cost $5,793 (2027 page), plus $48 application fee and a 2.5% card fee. Financial aid is available for admitted students with need, but not guaranteed.
deadline_text: Application opens Jan 6, 2027 at 8:00 AM and closes Feb 5, 2027 (dates page says 5:00 PM). Financial aid forms postmarked by Feb 6, 2027. Decisions Mar 25, 2027.
how_to_apply: Online application plus teacher recommendations and parent signature. Pay the application fee. If accepted, pay one-third by Apr 7, 2027 and the rest by Apr 16, 2027.
notes: Competitive. Residential, so you live on campus for four weeks. Financial aid is reviewed separately from admission and needs a parent income document; it has a hard deadline. Program session dates are listed as TBA. Pick UC Davis as your campus on the application. COSMOS runs on several UC campuses (UC Davis, UC Irvine, UC San Diego and UC Santa Cruz); this card is the Davis campus. See the UC COSMOS site for the others: https://jacobs.ucsd.edu/cosmos
